correctness.rationale: Direct substitution in the physical and induced branch formulas proves each interior ±1 arrow and the deterministic endpoint reflections with strict half-open inequalities; detailed balance yields the normalized unique-on-this-subgraph stationary measure and both gate masses. Cosine eigenfunctions diagonalize the reflected path and eigenvalue −1 explains period two. On the two-sided dyadic lattice f0(q_j)=q_{j−1}, f1(q_j)=q_{j+1} for the entire positive permitted parameter range; the index is an iid fair ±1 walk, so Lévy arcsine law applies after a negligible O(sqrt(N)) expected boundary-visitation correction. Independently checked exact fractions and stationary distributions for all 2≤k≤60. No claim of whole-core uniqueness or arcsine law for every physical initial point.
